name: Miraval Arizona Resort & Spa
positioning: Adults-only wellness resort on 400 acres of Sonoran Desert against the Santa Catalina Mountains, just north of Tucson, where meals and spa access are included
best_for: Adults wanting a screen-free wellness retreat with daily classes, activities and spa time
Travelers drawn to desert hiking, equine experiences and one-on-one sessions with specialists

facts.text: Miraval Arizona is set across 400 acres of the Sonoran Desert.
The resort stretches against the Santa Catalina Mountains just north of Tucson.
All meals, snacks, coffee, smoothies and non-alcoholic beverages are included, with an additional charge for premium zero-proof cocktails.
Stays include full access to the Life in Balance Spa.
Spa treatments range from acupuncture to Ayurveda to water-based sessions in a private pool.
Stays include a nightly resort credit that can be applied to spa services, fee-based activities or private sessions.
The resort offers an extensive menu of daily workshops, classes, lectures and activities, many of them complimentary.
Most activities are available as private one-on-one sessions with specialists.
Miraval Immersions are multi-day masterclass programs created by specialists.
Guest rooms have in-room meditation channels and a Himalayan singing bowl.
Accommodation ranges from standard rooms to multi-bedroom villas.

highlights.text: The Retreats have at least 600 square feet, an indoor/outdoor shower and a patio with a private in-ground hot tub.
Guests can hike up Mt. Lemmon, try therapeutic drumming and spend time with horses at Purple Sage Ranch.
Most of the property is a screen-free zone, and guests receive a linen sleeping bag for storing digital devices.
The Vasudhara spa service combines Thai stretches, bodywork and a warm water float.

considerations.text: Miraval welcomes guests aged 18 and older.
The resort sits almost an hour from Tucson International Airport; stays include a shared shuttle from the airport.
Guests may check in as early as 11 a.m., but rooms may not be ready until several hours later.
